wait_trace_audit.scope: performance indices 130..259, all 8 ranks, parsed from each arm rank*.log
wait_trace_audit.meaning: Every measured external wait slept for at least one 1 ms interval. The 1 ms wall is host sleep quantization, not device communication latency. P2A_WAIT_PROGRESS is emitted only after 1000 ms, not after every 1 ms sleep.

code_audit: wait_with_trace uses nonblocking scal_completion_group_wait followed by sleep_for(1ms) on SCAL_TIMED_OUT; successful waits also log and flush in both arms.

run_rank performs H2D initialization and synchronization before each call and D2H plus full CPU output verification after each call. These are outside wall_us but affect completion-to-completion cadence.

The direct performance arm additionally executes log_sync_state, validate_addresses and log_dynamic_state after the measured wall endpoint; native does not. These asymmetric costs affect the next completion-to-completion interval.
same_packets runs inside direct submit_us, not outside it. It cannot be treated as an unmeasured post-completion explanation for the 30.205 us difference.

The direct-only inter-call work makes the +2.56% completion-span difference invalid as a device regression result, but the existing artifacts do not apportion that difference exactly among diagnostics, validation, logging and scheduling.

metric_verdicts.submit_us: Descriptive host-path microbenchmark only. Direct includes same_packets validation. It is not an end-to-end or production-saving measurement.
metric_verdicts.wall_us: Invalid for device communication latency because of 1 ms sleep and wait logging.
metric_verdicts.completion_to_completion_us: Invalid for isolated device communication time because it includes host sleep, copies, verification and asymmetric direct-only diagnostics.

historical_10_32_us_correction.actual_scope: 6144 FP32 elements per rank (24 KiB send, 192 KiB receive), 141 back-to-back collectives, device event span 1455.78 us divided by 141
historical_10_32_us_correction.not_scope: A single 1024-element (4 KiB send, 32 KiB receive) AllGather in the P2a loop

model_extrapolation_correction: 142 * 8.21 us = 1.166 ms is arithmetic host-work extrapolation, not measured TPOT or end-to-end savings. It does not establish overlap, critical-path, message-size, collective-type or P3 closed-loop benefits.
required_retest: No sleep or success-path logging in timed waits.
No direct-only same_packets, sync-state, address-validation or dynamic-decoding work in measured loops.
Keep native and direct loop boundaries and inter-call work identical.
Report host submit and wall separately from device timestamps; do not call completion-to-completion pure device latency while copies and verification remain.
Use independent-process ABBA and preserve raw per-rank samples.
